import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re

ACC = {"Tar_ECOLI":"P07017","Tsr_ECOLI":"P02942","Tar_SALTY":"P02941","Trg_ECOLI":"P07018",
       "McpA_BACSU":"P39214","McpB_BACSU":"P39215","McpC_BACSU":"P54576",
       "TlpA_BACSU":"P39216","TlpB_BACSU":"P39217","TlpC_BACSU":"P39209"}
SEQ={k:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=30).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in ACC.items()}
b62="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V  B  Z  X  *
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0 -2 -1  0 -4
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -4
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3  3  0 -1 -4
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3  4  1 -1 -4
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -3 -2 -4

I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3 -3 -3 -1 -4
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1 -4 -3 -1 -4
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  0  1 -1 -4
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1 -3 -1 -1 -4
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1 -3 -3 -1 -4
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2 -2 -1 -2 -4

L=b62.strip().split("\n");cols=L[0].split();AAI={a:i for i,a in enumerate(cols)}
MM=np.zeros((len(cols),len(cols)),dtype=int)
for l in L[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): MM[AAI[p[0]],AAI[c]]=int(v)
def s1(a,b): return MM[AAI.get(a,AAI['X']),AAI.get(b,AAI['X'])]

tip={k:re.search(r"G[FLIV][ASG]VVA[DEG]EVR",s).start()+1 for k,s in SEQ.items()}

def offset_scan(ref, ra, rb, tgt, search_lo, search_hi):
    """Ungapped: slide ref segment [ra,rb] over target; return DataFrame offset->score.
       offset d means ref position p aligns to target position p+d."""
    rs,ts=SEQ[ref],SEQ[tgt]; seg=rs[ra-1:rb]
    rows=[]
    for d in range(search_lo,search_hi+1):
        if ra+d-1<0 or rb+d>len(ts): continue
        tseg=ts[ra+d-1:rb+d]
        rows.append((d,sum(s1(x,y) for x,y in zip(seg,tseg))))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["offset","score"])

# --- MH1: Tar 280-330 (contains sites 295,302,309) slid over McpB ---
print("MH1 joint offset scan, Tar(280-330) vs each B. subtilis receptor")
mh1_rows=[]
for tgt in ["McpB_BACSU","McpA_BACSU","McpC_BACSU","TlpA_BACSU","TlpB_BACSU","TlpC_BACSU"]:
    d=offset_scan("Tar_ECOLI",280,330,tgt, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]-60, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]+60)
    d=d.sort_values("score",ascending=False)
    best=d.iloc[0]; second=d.iloc[1]
    # best offset excluding +-3 of best (to find the next independent register)
    d2=d[(d.offset-best.offset).abs()>3]
    nxt=d2.iloc[0]
    ts=SEQ[tgt]
    mapped={p: (p+int(best.offset), ts[p+int(best.offset)-1]) for p in [295,302,309]}
    mh1_rows.append(dict(target=tgt, best_off=int(best.offset), best_score=int(best.score),
                         next_indep_off=int(nxt.offset), next_score=int(nxt.score),
                         margin=int(best.score-nxt.score),
                         Tar_Q295_to="%s%d"%(mapped[295][1],mapped[295][0]),
                         Tar_E302_to="%s%d"%(mapped[302][1],mapped[302][0]),
                         Tar_Q309_to="%s%d"%(mapped[309][1],mapped[309][0])))
mh1=pd.DataFrame(mh1_rows); pd.set_option("display.width",250)
print(mh1.to_string(index=False))

print("\nMH2 joint offset scan, Tar(470-520) (contains site 491) vs each B. subtilis receptor")
mh2_rows=[]
for tgt in ["McpB_BACSU","McpA_BACSU","McpC_BACSU","TlpA_BACSU","TlpB_BACSU","TlpC_BACSU"]:
    d=offset_scan("Tar_ECOLI",470,520,tgt, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]-60, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]+60)
    d=d.sort_values("score",ascending=False); best=d.iloc[0]
    d2=d[(d.offset-best.offset).abs()>3]; nxt=d2.iloc[0]
    ts=SEQ[tgt]; q=491+int(best.offset)
    mh2_rows.append(dict(target=tgt,best_off=int(best.offset),best_score=int(best.score),
                         next_score=int(nxt.score),margin=int(best.score-nxt.score),
                         Tar_E491_to="%s%d"%(ts[q-1],q)))
print(pd.DataFrame(mh2_rows).to_string(index=False))

# Figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
for tgt,c in [("McpB_BACSU","tab:blue"),("McpC_BACSU","tab:red"),("TlpA_BACSU","tab:green")]:
    d=offset_scan("Tar_ECOLI",280,330,tgt, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]-60, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]+60)
    ax[0].plot(d.offset+309, d.score, label=tgt.split('_')[0], color=c, lw=1.2)
ax[0].axvline(371,ls='--',c='k',lw=0.8); ax[0].text(371,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.98,' McpB Q371',fontsize=8,va='top')
ax[0].set_xlabel("B. subtilis residue aligned to Tar Q309"); ax[0].set_ylabel("ungapped BLOSUM62 score, Tar 280-330")
ax[0].set_title("MH1 register scan"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
for tgt,c in [("McpB_BACSU","tab:blue"),("McpC_BACSU","tab:red"),("TlpA_BACSU","tab:green")]:
    d=offset_scan("Tar_ECOLI",470,520,tgt, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]-60, tip[tgt]-tip["Tar_ECOLI"]+60)
    ax[1].plot(d.offset+491, d.score, label=tgt.split('_')[0], color=c, lw=1.2)
for p in (595,630,637):
    ax[1].axvline(p,ls='--',c='grey',lw=0.7)
ax[1].set_xlabel("B. subtilis residue aligned to Tar E491"); ax[1].set_ylabel("ungapped BLOSUM62 score, Tar 470-520")
ax[1].set_title("MH2 register scan (dashed: McpB Q595, E630, E637)"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
